title: Federal Register: Submission for OMB Review; Central Contractor Registration (OMB Control No. 9000-0159)

history.reason: Source read directly (PDF from GovInfo converted to text) on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

publisher: DoD, GSA and NASA (via GovInfo / Federal Register)
source_type: Government Paperwork Reduction Act notice (extension of SAM/CCR registration collection)
reliability: Government document; the issuing agencies (DoD, GSA, NASA) also administer the registration and certification requirements they estimate. Burden figures are agency estimates, not measurements.
findings: The notice covers the FAR subpart 4.11 contractor registration database (then called Central Contractor Registration); both current and potential vendors must register to be awarded Federal contracts.
The notice describes a one-time registration to provide basic information, with an update or renewal at least once per year to maintain active status.
Annual reporting burden: 110,350 respondents, 1 response per respondent, 110,350 annual responses, 1.7141 hours per response, 189,151 total burden hours.
The notice states no comments were received on the earlier 60-day notice.
limitations: Dated 2016 and written when the database was still called Central Contractor Registration; SAM was later changed (for example, UEI replaced DUNS) and the 2016 figures may not reflect current effort.
Agency ex ante estimate; the notice gives no method, no breakdown by business size, and no separation of first-time registration from annual renewal.
The collection was later consolidated into other OMB control numbers (see the 2025 source), so this figure is not current.
